scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env')) console.warn('Falta .env. Copia la plantilla .env.example y completa los valores reales antes de arrancar el ERP.'); else console.log('Entorno listo para ERP Universal Modular.');"
scripts.build: npm --workspace backend run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace backend run lint && npm --workspace apps/web run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace backend run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/mobile run typecheck
